Create integration test with full pipeline (AC: #1-#10)

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Input: List of fixtures with AI analysis (from Story 4.4)
Calculate EV for each market using Story 5.1 (ev_calculator)
Score confidence for each pick using Story 5.3 (confidence_scorer)
Filter by 5% EV threshold using Story 5.2 (threshold_filter)
Output: List of `Pick` objects with fields: fixture_id, market, ai_probability, implied_probability, ev_percentage, confidence, recommended_stake, suggested_odds
Log summary: Total picks found, picks above threshold, edge distribution (mean EV, min/max), confidence distribution (high/medium/low tiers)
Handle "NO PICKS" case gracefully - return user-friendly message if no picks above threshold
Transform EVResult + ConfidenceScoreBreakdown into Pick objects

doc.title: System Architecture
doc.snippet: Purpose: Three-step pipeline to identify positive EV opportunities. Step 1: Calculate EV for each market (Story 5.1). Step 2: Filter by 5% EV threshold (Story 5.2). Step 3: Score confidence based on data quality (Story 5.3). Output: Clean list of Pick objects with all metadata.

doc.title: System Architecture
doc.snippet: Formula: stake = bankroll × (EV_percentage * 0.1) × (confidence / 100). Example: $1000 bankroll, 5% EV, 80% confidence = 1000 × 0.005 × 0.8 = $4. Conservative multiplier with confidence scaling.

doc.title: Story 5.1: Expected Value Calculation
doc.snippet: Batch processing function: `async def calculate_all_evs(fixtures: list[Fixture]) -> list[Fixture]` that attaches EV data to fixtures. Returns fixtures with `ev_results` field populated containing list of EVResult objects.

doc.title: Story 5.2: Threshold Filter
doc.snippet: Categorize picks into RECOMMENDED (≥5%), MARGINAL (2-5%), LOW (<2%), INVALID. Function `categorize_picks(ev_results)` returns dict with all categories. 5% threshold is non-negotiable discipline requirement.

doc.title: Story 5.2: Threshold Filter
doc.snippet: Function `no_picks_available_message(ev_results, threshold_pct)` returns formatted message when no RECOMMENDED picks exist. Includes summary of categories found (MARGINAL, LOW, INVALID counts) and suggests user action.

doc.title: Story 5.3: Confidence Scoring
doc.snippet: Function `apply_confidence_scoring(picks, fixtures)` returns list of ConfidenceScoreBreakdown objects. Base score: 75%. Adjustments: form (+15 to -5), injuries (+5 to -10), odds (+5 to -10), final confidence clamped to [0, 100].

doc.title: Project Requirements
doc.snippet: Edge detection phase combines EV calculation, threshold filtering, and confidence scoring to identify betting opportunities. Output feeds to stake sizing (Phase 6) and display (Phase 7).

package.name: pydantic
package.description: Data validation and Pydantic models (v2 syntax)

constraints.constraint: 5% EV threshold is non-negotiable discipline - never lower this threshold
Pipeline must orchestrate exact order: EV calculation → threshold filtering → confidence scoring → Pick transformation
Input fixtures MUST have ai_analysis field populated from Story 4.4 (OpenAI batch analysis)
Graceful degradation: if any step fails for a single pick, log error and continue (don't raise exception for entire batch)
Log progress for each step and comprehensive summary statistics at end (total picks, threshold breakdown, EV distribution, confidence tiers)
Formula: stake = bankroll × (ev_percentage * 0.01 * 0.1) × (confidence / 100). Clamp stake to reasonable % of bankroll (e.g., max 5%)
Return type must handle both success (list[Pick]) and no-picks case (user-friendly message string)
Use timezone-aware UTC datetime (datetime.now(timezone.utc), NOT datetime.utcnow() which is deprecated)
All functions must have explicit return type annotations. Use Python 3.14+ syntax: list[X] not List[X], X | None not Optional[X]
Use Pydantic v2 syntax: @field_validator not @validator, ConfigDict not Config class, field_validator(..., mode="before"|"after")

interface.name: detect_edges()
interface.signature: async def detect_edges(fixtures: list[Fixture], bankroll: float = 1000.0) -> list[Pick] | str
interface.description: Main orchestrator function. Takes fixtures with ai_analysis, runs EV→threshold→confidence pipeline, returns list of Pick objects or NO_PICKS message

interface.name: calculate_all_evs()
interface.description: Calculates EV for all markets in fixtures. Returns fixtures with ev_results field populated (list[EVResult])

interface.name: apply_threshold_filter()
interface.signature: async def apply_threshold_filter(fixtures: list[Fixture], threshold_pct: float = 5.0) -> dict[str, Any]
interface.description: Filters EVResults by 5% threshold. Returns dict with keys: recommended (list[FilteredPick]), marginal, low, total, has_picks (bool)

interface.name: apply_confidence_scoring()
interface.signature: async def apply_confidence_scoring(picks: list[EVResult], fixtures: list[Fixture]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]
interface.description: Scores confidence for each pick based on data freshness. Returns list of dicts with confidence breakdown and scores

interface.name: no_picks_available_message()
interface.signature: def no_picks_available_message(ev_results: list[EVResult], threshold_pct: float = 5.0) -> str
interface.description: Generates user-friendly message when no picks above threshold. Includes summary of categories found and statistics

interface.name: Pick model
interface.signature: class Pick(BaseModel): fixture_id, market, ai_probability, implied_probability, ev_percentage, confidence, recommended_stake, suggested_odds
interface.description: Output model for betting picks. All Story 5.4 picks must conform to this schema

standards.paragraph: Testing standards for Story 5.4 follow project patterns: pytest framework with async support (pytest-asyncio). Test organization by function (TestDetectEdges, TestStakeCalculation). Coverage target: 80% overall, 100% for critical paths. Test naming convention: `test_[scenario]_[expected_result]`. Include edge cases (empty list, no picks, single fixture) and error scenarios (missing timestamps, stale data).

Error handling tests: Verify graceful degradation when individual steps fail. Data validation tests: Verify Pick objects have all required fields. Integration tests: End-to-end pipeline with realistic fixture data from Stories 5.1-5.3. Stake calculation tests: Verify formula correctness with boundary conditions and various bankroll/EV/confidence combinations.

locations.location: Unit tests for detect_edges() orchestrator, stake calculation, summary statistics, no-picks handling (30+ test cases)
Integration tests with full pipeline (15+ test cases), using real Fixture/EVResult/ConfidenceScoreBreakdown models

ideas.idea: Test detect_edges() initialization: async function callable, accepts fixtures and optional bankroll parameter
Test EV calculation step: calls calculate_all_evs(), attaches ev_results to fixtures
Test threshold filtering step: calls apply_threshold_filter(), extracts RECOMMENDED picks
Test confidence scoring step: calls apply_confidence_scoring(), returns ConfidenceScoreBreakdown for each pick
Test Pick transformation: EVResult + ConfidenceScoreBreakdown → Pick object with all fields populated
Test summary statistics: mean/min/max EV, confidence tier counts (high/medium/low), total and threshold-filtered counts
Test NO_PICKS message: empty recommended picks list → calls no_picks_available_message(), returns formatted string
Test stake calculation formula: bankroll × (ev_pct * 0.01 * 0.1) × (confidence/100) with various inputs, verify clamping
Test Pick object completeness: all required fields present (fixture_id, market, ai_probability, implied_probability, ev_percentage, confidence, recommended_stake, suggested_odds)
Test error resilience: if confidence_scorer fails for one pick, log error and continue processing others
